ambient_atomic_oxygen.caveat: ram-facing external surface, directed flux only; the emitter sits inside the cathode behind the Xe flow and orifice (attenuation TBD). No published LaB6 threshold for atomic O was found, so these values are NOT compared with the O2 thresholds; they only show the scale the shielding must handle.
